title: Shadow Demon in Blossom
description: A black silhouetted demonic female figure with horns and a long dripping tail sits on a green table. She holds a branch of yellow cherry blossoms that arc over her, while three transparent orbs on the table display miniature scenes of a couple by water under moonlight.
prompt: A black silhouette of a female demon with horns and a long dripping tail sits on a green draped table, pink liquid dripping from her eyes. A flowering cherry blossom branch with yellow flowers curves over her head against a swirling blue sky filled with floating eyes and colorful spiral patterns. Three crystal orbs rest on the table showing miniature romantic scenes of couples by a lake under moonlight, petals falling everywhere.
